description: Four units whose lossless extension is of version 2, which 8.3.1 does not describe, so its channel sets are not read.

crosscheck.decode_error: XLL stream version 2 is not implemented

skip.ffprobe_bitrate: ffmpeg's lossless decoder sets the bit rate to 0 (dca_xll.c: avctx->bit_rate = 0), so ffprobe lists none
skip.ffprobe_profile: ffmpeg names the lossless profile when its decoder has decoded a frame (dca_xll.c), which it does not here, so ffprobe names the core's
skip.decode: ffmpeg's decoder does not implement a newer version (dca_xll.c: 'XLL stream version 2')
